$comment: DGA Platforms Code component anatomy, extracted by /dga-sync. Feeds the judged checks P1-P3 — the auditor reads this to know what a compliant button or input actually measures, instead of guessing from a screenshot. Measurements are the values bound to the component's own Figma variables, in px.
$notes: Measurements here are the component-scoped variables the library binds (Button/buttons-*-padding, Form/Input-container-padding-*, Card/card-lg-gap, Notification/notification-*). Heights were not exposed as variables and are left null rather than measured off a screenshot.

The library has 48 component pages. Four are recorded here — the ones a compliance audit meets most often. Extend by running get_variable_defs on the remaining page ids as audits turn up components not covered.

Variant and state names come from the button token families (primary / neutral / black / oncolor / transparent / danger-primary / danger-secondary, each with default, hovered, pressed, selected, focused, disabled), which is the library's own state model.

SYNC 2 — Foundations (1392267405633663431) added Table anatomy from the Effect styles page. Button, Text input, Card and Inline alert measurements were re-confirmed against Foundations and did not change.

SYNC 3 — Mobile Components (1392271796654597578). Button, Text input and Card measurements were re-extracted from the mobile file and are IDENTICAL to desktop, value for value. Hence appliesTo: [desktop, mobile] rather than per-viewport specs — the library publishes one component spec and varies only the shell.

Mobile-only shell: Tab Bar (recorded), Navigation Bar (present, not measured), Splash Screen and Nav Drawer (not extracted). Desktop equivalents are Nav Header, Second Level Nav Header, Table of Contents and Footer.

The Controls/ token family (checkbox, radio, switch) arrived with this sync but the checkbox geometry itself was not measured; Checkbox was the held-back cross-check page and only its variables were read.

source.publisher: SDGA / Digital Government Authority, Saudi Arabia

components.name: Button
components.anatomy: Optional leading icon, label, optional trailing icon. Gap is 4 at every size — only the inline padding and type step change. Corner is radius-sm (4) throughout, not the size-dependent radius some systems use.

components.name: Text input
components.anatomy: Label above field with an 8 gap; field carries a 1px border (border colour changes per state), radius-sm (4). Placeholder uses text-secondary-paragraph, filled text uses text-default. Error state swaps the border to field-border-error.

components.name: Card
components.anatomy: background-card on radius-lg (16), internal gap 24, title at Text lg/Bold (18/28). Elevation is Shadows/shadow-md when raised.

components.name: Inline alert / Notification
components.anatomy: Icon, then title at Text md/Semibold with body at Text sm/Regular separated by text-content-gap 8, then an optional button group with buttons-group-gap 8. Each variant pairs its background-<role>-25 surface with its border-<role>-light edge and text-<role> label — the three always move together.

components.name: Table
components.anatomy: Header row on table-background-header #f3f4f6 with table-text-head #384250; cells separated by table-cell-border #d2d6db. Cell padding is 16 inline / 8 block with an 8 gap between cell contents.

components.name: UI Shell — Tab Bar
components.anatomy: Bottom bar 84 tall across a 375 viewport. Each tab item is 46x70 (54 wide in RTL — the item widens rather than the label truncating), icon over a 12/18 label, tab-button-gap 4. Supports 1-5 tabs plus a no-selection state, each with an on-color variant. Badge indicators are 12x12 small, 16x16 large, 30x16 with max digits.

components.name: UI Shell — Navigation Bar
components.anatomy: Mobile top bar. Present in the library and recorded so an auditor knows it exists; measurements not yet extracted.
